reasons: The cap edit is exactly on-position: greater-of structure, lowercase fee basis anchored to "the 12 months preceding the claim" and under this Agreement rather than the first Order Form, plus the USD 1,000,000 limb; mutuality and the full carve-out list survive untouched, so the preferred level is complete.

The second operation is unnecessary for the preferred level. The original 21.3 already stated that Customer's payment obligation is not damages, satisfying the "payment obligations are not damages" element; rewriting it was not needed to complete the cap fix.

That second edit also cuts against us: replacing "undisputed Fees for conforming Services" with "all amounts due under this Agreement" strips the qualifiers that kept disputed amounts and amounts for non-conforming Services inside the limitation, expanding Customer's unlimited payment exposure. Recommend reverting 21.3's final sentence to the original wording.
